title: Consumer Rights
text: Consumer rights include the right to be protected against marketing of goods and services hazardous to life and property, the right to be informed about quality, quantity, potency, purity, standard and price, the right to be assured access to variety at competitive prices, and the right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices.

title: Filing a Consumer Complaint
text: A consumer or recognized consumer association may file a complaint with the District Commission electronically or in writing regarding defective goods, deficient services, unfair trade practices, or overcharging beyond the displayed price.

title: Unfair Trade Practice & Dark Patterns
text: Unfair trade practice means adopting any unfair method or deceptive practice for promoting the sale, use or supply of any goods or services, including falsely representing standard or quality, misleading advertisements, or refusing to take back defective goods.

title: Request for Obtaining Information
text: A citizen desiring to obtain any information under this Act shall make a request in writing or through electronic means in English, Hindi, or the official language of the area, accompanying the prescribed fee, to the Central Public Information Officer without being required to give any reason for requesting the information.

title: 30-Day Disposal Time Limit
text: The Central Public Information Officer shall, as expeditiously as possible and in any case within thirty days of the receipt of the request, either provide the information on payment of the prescribed fee or reject the request for reasons specified under sections 8 and 9. Where the information concerns the life or liberty of a person, it shall be provided within forty-eight hours.

title: Penalty for Damage to Computer System
text: If any person without permission of the owner accesses, downloads, copies, extracts data, introduces any computer contaminant or virus, or disrupts any computer system or network, they shall be liable to pay damages by way of compensation to the person so affected.

title: Punishment for Identity Theft
text: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly makes use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one lakh rupees.

title: Consent for Personal Data Processing
text: Consent given by the Data Principal shall be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action, and shall signify an agreement to the processing of personal data for the specified purpose and be limited to such personal data as is necessary for that specified purpose. The Data Principal has the right to withdraw consent at any time.

title: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty
text: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law. The Supreme Court has interpreted Article 21 to include the fundamental right to privacy, dignity, clean environment, and livelihood.

title: Freedom of Speech and Expression
text: All citizens shall have the right to freedom of speech and expression, subject to reasonable restrictions under Article 19(2) in the interests of sovereignty and integrity of India, security of the State, public order, decency or morality.
